name: gg.agnt/agnt
title: AGNT
description: Search 100 agent skills, 100 MCP servers, AI tool shutdowns and AGNT research guides.

tools.name: agnt_skills_search
tools.description: Search AGNT's directory of 100 reviewed AI agent skills (SKILL.md) for Claude Code, Codex and other agents, and get each skill's source and install guide. Example: agnt_skills_search(query="frontend design") returns the Frontend Design skill with its GitHub source and install guide. Covers official skills from Anthropic, Google, Vercel and Cloudflare, each re-checked on GitHub.

query.description: What the skill should help with, for example "frontend design" or "PDF forms".

limit.description: How many results to return (1–10, default 5).

tools.name: agnt_mcp_servers_search
tools.description: Search AGNT's guide to 100 MCP servers, grouped by job, and get each server's best use and source link. Example: agnt_mcp_servers_search(query="postgres") returns Postgres MCP Pro and the PostgreSQL reference server with links to their repositories. Covers the official reference servers plus servers for GitHub, Sentry, Figma, Supabase, Stripe and more.

query.description: The job or system to connect, for example "postgres" or "browser automation".

limit.description: How many results to return (1–10, default 5).

tools.name: agnt_ai_shutdowns_check
tools.description: Check whether an AI tool, API or model is being shut down, with the date, what stops and where the vendor points you. Example: agnt_ai_shutdowns_check(query="Agent Builder") returns OpenAI Agent Builder: 30 Nov 2026, with the replacement and the vendor notice. Covers announced 2026–2027 shutdowns, checked against vendor notices. Leave query empty to list them all.

query.description: A product, API or model name, for example "gpt-4o". Optional.

limit.description: How many results to return (1–10, default 5).

tools.name: agnt_research_search
tools.description: Search AGNT's sourced guides and comparisons on AI agents, harnesses, MCP, local AI, coding agents and automation, and get each page's title, summary and link. Example: agnt_research_search(query="claude code vs codex") returns the Claude Code vs Codex comparison. Covers every research article and comparison published on agnt.gg.

query.description: The topic or question, for example "agent harness" or "local AI hardware".

limit.description: How many results to return (1–10, default 5).
